calculation.description: Ranks assets by the negative five-day return normalized by trailing 20-day realized volatility; daily cross-sectional median is removed. Positive values indicate relatively poor recent risk-adjusted performance and are expected to mean-revert upward. Signal uses completed data through t only.

signal_artifact.data_alignment: Signal at t uses close through t; forward return uses t+1 close; union-date prices are forward-filled only across observed asset histories.

metrics.correlation_note: Not computed in this cycle; deterministic post-Miner gate must recompute from signal artifacts.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in all regimes: 2020-2022 IC 0.04002, ICIR 0.12355 (1080 dates); 2023-2024 IC 0.02097, ICIR 0.06438 (731 dates); 2025-2026 IC 0.02603, ICIR 0.08210 (610 dates). Small 15-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
